# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixes the WinUI .NET 9 projection DLL.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI .NET 9 projection DLL resolved** — The SkiaSharp WinUI package no longer throws a DLL-not-found error for .NET 9 consumers. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs backported** — Library targets now use the versioned Apple 26.0 TFMs while app targets use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions for Xcode 26. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
